stem: A 3-year-old has no spoken words, poor eye contact and becomes very distressed if toy trains are moved out of a particular line. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanation: Poor eye contact, absent language and restricted repetitive play are characteristic of autism spectrum disorder. Hearing impairment should be assessed, but the restricted and repetitive behaviour strongly supports autism.
